expected_level_description: You can: - manage a caseload of complex cases, advising hearing panels on fair outcomes - carry out or lead investigations, including those linked to incidents or safeguarding - use early resolution and mediation to settle disputes before they escalate - spot trends in cases and act on their causes

You can: - interpret employment law and policy for complex cases and advise on risk - draft and review people policies, with equality impact assessments - consult on policy changes with staff representatives
You can: - support managers to prepare consultation documents and staff briefings - track responses and actions during consultation - support staff through redeployment and selection processes

You can: - prepare contracts, variation letters, and employment checks accurately - process changes in the HR and payroll system against deadlines - answer routine questions from managers and staff about HR processes
You can: - run standard workforce reports and check them for errors - answer routine information requests about the workforce

You can: - apply pay rules, such as starting salary, protection, and allowances - check job descriptions are complete before they go to evaluation - take part in job evaluation panels as a trained member

You can: - identify important stakeholders and communicate with them clearly and regularly - tailor communication to stakeholders' needs and work with them to build relationships while meeting user needs - build and reach consensus with stakeholders - work to improve stakeholder relationships using evidence to explain decisions
You can: - recognise and challenge behaviour that excludes others - consider different needs when you plan your work
You can: - carry out simple risk assessments, such as workstation assessments - help colleagues work safely
You can: - describe the main parts of the health and care system and the services the organisation supports - explain why patient safety and confidentiality matter in your work
